enable_verbose.description: Enable verbose output during policy compilation (helps diagnose loading issues).

max_recursion.description: Maximum recursion depth for nested includes/profile includes (avoid stack overflow).

include_dirs.description: List of directories to scan for additional AppArmor configuration files (e.g., profile.d/).

items.description: A directory path containing AppArmor config fragments or profiles.

include_dirs_verbose.description: If true, prepend verbose comments to include directives.

include_syntax.description: Directive used for including external files (typically 'include' or 'runtime_include').

helper_dir.description: Path to AppArmor helper binaries and scripts used during policy compilation.

enable_inotify.description: Enable inotify-based monitoring of /etc/apparmor.d for hot-reloading profile changes.

enforce_mode.description: Global enforcement mode: 0 = disable enforcement (no policy applied), 1 = enforce (block violations), 2 = complain (log but allow).

enable_cache.description: Enable on-disk cache of compiled profiles for faster reloads (recommended for production).

cache_dir.description: Path to the directory where compiled profiles are cached.

cache_dir_mode.description: Permission mode (octal) for the cache directory.

cache_file_mode.description: Permission mode (octal) for cached profile files.

enable_networking.description: Enable support for network namespace and socket rules (required for network-aware profiles).

enable_mount.description: Enable support for mount-related rules (e.g., bind mounts, pivot_root).

enable_signal.description: Enable support for signal rules (ptrace, kill, etc.) — needed for debugging or inter-process control.

enable_hooks.description: Enable hook scripts that run before/after policy load/unload (e.g., preload modules).

debug.description: Enable debug-mode logging (very verbose; use only for troubleshooting).

default_complain.description: If true, apply 'complain' mode by default to newly loaded profiles.

use_abstractions.description: Whether to automatically include standard abstraction files (e.g., 'common', 'x11').

abstractions.description: List of abstraction names to include by default (each maps to abstractions/<name> in helper_dir).

items.description: Name of a standard abstraction file (e.g., 'common', 'nss').

site_profiles.description: List of paths to site-specific profile files or directories to include.

items.description: Absolute path to a profile file (e.g., '/etc/apparmor.d/usr.bin.firefox').
